observed_source_fact.detail: derive_authority_cohort_id validates one cohort plan and uniqueness of grid_cell_id, controller_observed_node_id, controller_observed_pid, launch_descriptor_sha256, executor_observation_sha256 and raw_node_result_packet_digest. It does not explicitly require source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256 to be unique across cohort members.
observed_source_fact.test_coverage_observation: The existing negative test named test_reusing_same_call_observation_across_two_cells_is_rejected duplicates executor_observation_sha256. It does not construct two distinct launch descriptors and two distinct executor observations that both reference the same exact source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256.

hypothesis.H1: For a physical/logical GRID10 cohort in which each member represents one independently attributed model invocation, the exact source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256 must be injective over cohort members. Otherwise one exact call can be projected into multiple distinct cell/node authority envelopes.
hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Unique launch descriptors and executor observations are sufficient because every cell has a distinct provenance record even when they refer to the same exact model call.
hypothesis.counterassessment: Distinct records prove distinct bookkeeping events, not distinct model invocations. The existing source-bound call identity is the identity of the exact call; allowing two members to reference one call weakens claims about per-cell invocation multiplicity and causal attribution.
hypothesis.boundary_condition: If a future HCU mode intentionally permits one exact model call to fan out into multiple logical consumers, that must be represented as one call with explicit fan-out/consumer identities, not silently counted as multiple independently executed calls.

construction: Build member A with launch A, executor observation A and exact call C.
Build member B with distinct node, cell, PID, node admission, launch B and executor observation B, but reuse exact call C and its exact output/ABI/source identities.
Keep all currently enforced uniqueness fields distinct and valid.
Ask derive_authority_cohort_id to admit the two-member fixture.

recommended_minimal_delta.source_change: In derive_authority_cohort_id add source_bound_model_call_identity_sha256 to the cohort-level injective identity checks.
recommended_minimal_delta.positive_control: Two distinct exact model calls may share the same semantic output identity if all call identities and required invocation identities are distinct.
do_not_do: Do not create a second model-call identity schema.
Do not move call identity into the model-generated NODE_RESULT payload.
Do not infer runtime or GRID10 promotion from this source-only audit.
